name: English Stand-Up Comedy Open Mic
description: Kick off the weekend with a night of laughs at this free open mic, perfect for catching new comedic talent.
longDescription:
This English Stand-Up Comedy Open Mic at Maria Pistolas offers a platform for emerging and established comedians to test new material and hone their craft. The event is a regular fixture in Porto's nightlife scene, providing a consistent opportunity for performers to engage with an audience in a supportive environment. It serves as a community hub for the city's English-speaking comedy talent.

Attendees can expect an evening of varied comedic styles, with sets typically ranging from short bursts of new jokes to more developed routines. The atmosphere is generally relaxed and informal, encouraging audience participation and laughter. The event is conducted entirely in English, attracting both local residents and visitors to Porto. Maria Pistolas is known for its intimate setting, which fosters a close connection between performers and the audience.

Admission to the open mic is free, with walk-ins welcome. The event takes place on 2026-09-24. Maria Pistolas is located within walking distance of the Aliados metro station, approximately a 7-minute walk.
